questions.question: What did Asa do when Baasha of Israel threatened Judah?
options: Made a treaty with Ben-hadad of Syria using temple treasures
Trusted in God fully and waited quietly for his deliverance
Fled away with his entire household up into the distant hills
Surrendered the whole city to the enemy without a fight
questions.answer: Made a treaty with Ben-hadad of Syria using temple treasures
